fusions.name: Still, Then Bite
fusions.desc: You hold still, then dart at one enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 13 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sluggish Swarm
fusions.desc: Sends a cold, slow rat at the first enemy in line, where it deals 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Grow It Back
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
